summary: Implemented the window title setting in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was committed and no tests were run, per instructions; verification was by reading the code only.
